name: search-issues-and-pull-requests
description: Searches GitHub issues and pull requests across every repository you can see, with GitHub's search syntax (is:open, is:pr, author:@me, repo:owner/name, label:bug). Each hit carries its repository as owner/repo and its number, which github__get-issue and github__get-pull-request take. Needs no id.

q.description: The search, in GitHub's search syntax (GitHub's own q parameter), e.g. is:open is:pr author:@me.

sort.description: Sort results by comments, creation time, or update time. Omit for best match.
